_schema.rule: Every new feature entry MUST include `outcome_metric` (named queryable metric + 90-day threshold + kill criterion). Features missing `outcome_metric` are invalid. The locked source of truth for outcome metrics is `~/Vaults/JKKNKB/Strategy/Locked-Initiatives.md` — features.json mirrors but does not override. See memory `feedback_outcome_metric_first.md` and `feedback_kill_criterion_forward_clauses_must_fire.md`.

outcome_metric_fields.metric_name: Queryable database column / dashboard chart / Supabase function output. Single number or yes/no on verdict-date. NOT 'improve X' or 'better Y'.
outcome_metric_fields.threshold_90d: Target value at verdict-date. Specific number.
outcome_metric_fields.kill_criterion: If threshold missed by X%, module is revised or formally archived.
outcome_metric_fields.verdict_date: ISO date — verdict-date from Locked-Initiatives.md (registry is canonical)

_schema.enforcement: Specs missing `outcome_metric` block are invalid. /myjkkn-chain Q0 enforces this gate at spec-time. Cross-domain commitments mirrored to ~/Vaults/JKKNKB/Strategy/Locked-Initiatives.md via /lock-initiative skill.

test_steps: Upload a file whose columns do NOT match the template — confirm it is REFUSED before any row is read (D23).
Upload a valid file — confirm every row gets a verdict (ok/flagged/blocked/no_match) and nothing is written yet.
Press Approve — confirm ONLY clean rows are promoted; flagged and no-match rows remain on a to-do list (D18).
Confirm an approved clean row writes canonical attribution (learners_profiles.referred_by_id), NOT a payment record (D20/D28).
Confirm an already-paid row is recorded to the double-pay ledger and cannot be paid again.
As a non-senior user, try to override a flag or edit an amount — confirm it is refused; as a senior user it works and is logged (D19/D22).
Edit a row's amount as senior — confirm the row is re-validated and the change is recorded.
Upload a second file containing a student already recorded from the first — confirm it is flagged 'already on record', not silently re-added (D24).
After approval, confirm the registrar enrolment check-list is auto-generated for exactly the claimed students (D25).
A matched student with recent attendance shows GREEN 'confirmed studying'; one without shows AMBER 'registrar to check' (D33).
Approving an already-paid row creates a 'paid' commission record, and the generator then SKIPS that learner (no double-pay) (D34).
A non-senior can upload and preview but the Approve-save button is disabled/blocked for them; a senior can approve (D35).
A row for a student already attributed to a DIFFERENT referrer is written as a DISPUTE against the existing record, NOT overwriting it (D36).
A row with agreed=5000, already_paid=3000 records 2000 as still owed; a row with only paid=3000 and no agreed figure records nothing owed (D37).
A clean row with a blank amount is recorded as 'amount to be set' and cannot be paid until an amount exists (D38).
Uploading a file where >~a third of rows don't match triggers a strong warning + confirm before any write (D39).
A non-admin, non-uploader cannot open a past upload's contents (D40).

features.name: F2 — Claim matching + exception report

outcome_metric.metric_name: Percentage of submitted 2025-26 referral claims resolved to exactly one bucket (matched / flagged-with-reason)
outcome_metric.baseline_value: 0% — 2025-26 has 0 attribution rows in learners_profiles (capture began 2026-02-26)
outcome_metric.threshold_90d: 100% of claims bucketed with zero silent drops by 2026-10-19
outcome_metric.kill_criterion: If >20% of claims cannot be matched to a real admission, STOP and re-request the source data — the file is not fit to pay from.

test_steps: Submit two claims naming the SAME student from different referrers — confirm BOTH are held and flagged, and NEITHER is payable (D12).
Submit a claim where referrer id equals the referred learner id — confirm it is BLOCKED outright (D11).
Submit a claim where referrer and student share a surname — confirm it is FLAGGED for review, NOT auto-rejected (D11).
Submit a claim naming a referral type but no resolvable referrer — confirm it lands on the review list and is not dropped (D13).
Sum matched + flagged and confirm it equals total rows submitted — proves zero silent drops.
Confirm a claim for a student outside admission year 2025-26 is rejected with that reason.
features.notes: Must reproduce the 135-unlinked class of failure as a FLAG, not a drop. referred_by_id has no FK and is polymorphic by referral_type (consultant→education_consultants, faculty→staff, student→learners_profiles) — the importer must validate the pointer.

features.name: F3 — Enrolment verification (attendance/feedback auto-confirm + registrar fallback)
features.priority: P0 — required by eligibility rule D6

outcome_metric.metric_name: Percentage of claimed students auto-confirmed by recent attendance/feedback, and percentage of the remainder confirmed by registrar, before payment
outcome_metric.baseline_value: lifecycle_status unusable (319 impossible 'graduated'); measured presence coverage ~53% of cohort have recent attendance/feedback, ~47% have NONE (college doesn't mark attendance in-system)
outcome_metric.threshold_90d: 100% of claimed students either auto-confirmed (attendance/feedback) or registrar-confirmed before approval; 0 auto-rejections on missing data; by 2026-10-19
outcome_metric.kill_criterion: If ANY claimed student is auto-rejected purely for missing attendance/feedback, HALT — absence of signal is a system-coverage gap, not proof of leaving (D30).

test_steps: Claim a student with recent 'Present' attendance — confirm they are AUTO-CONFIRMED with no registrar step (D29).
Claim a student who submitted recent session feedback but has no attendance — confirm auto-confirmed (feedback = presence).
Claim a student with NO attendance and NO feedback — confirm they go to the registrar worklist, and are NOT auto-rejected (D30).
Confirm a student whose only attendance is from February (stale) is NOT auto-confirmed under the this-term rule (D31) and falls to registrar.
Auto-confirm a student, then simulate them leaving, then run the payout — confirm the payment-time re-check catches it and blocks payment (D32).
Confirm no code path treats 'no attendance record' as 'not studying'.
features.notes: D29-D32. Auto-confirm = recent (this-term) attendance OR session_feedback = proof of presence. student_attendance.attendance_data is JSONB per-session (student_id+status inside); session_feedback.student_id is direct. No signal => registrar (NEVER auto-reject, D30). Re-check at payment time (D32). This REPLACES the manual-registrar-for-all approach.

outcome_metric.metric_name: Total net amount paid to agencies for AY 2025-26 with a named approver and bank reference on every transaction
outcome_metric.baseline_value: Rs.0 — consultant_payout_batches has 0 rows; no referral payment has ever been recorded
outcome_metric.threshold_90d: 100% of approved 2025-26 agency claims paid, each with approver + timestamp + reference, by 2026-10-19
outcome_metric.kill_criterion: If any payment can be recorded without a named approver, STOP the run — that is the exact defect PR #2219 fixed.

test_steps: Attempt to approve while signed in as the person who prepared the batch — confirm it is refused (D10 separation of duties).
Walk a batch through all four stages and confirm each stage records a distinct named user and timestamp.
Approve a transaction and re-query the DB — confirm status actually changed and approved_by/approved_at are set (regression test for the PGRST204 silent no-op).
Attempt to pay a claim already marked paid in the F1 history — confirm it is blocked.
Confirm a claim with unconfirmed enrolment (F3) cannot enter a batch.
Verify the batch total equals the sum of its transactions.
First real run: pay only a small group of agencies with complete bank details, confirm end-to-end, THEN widen (D27).
features.notes: Wave 1 = agencies only (D7). Rail is fully present: bank details, PAN/GST, and the prepare→review→approve→process chain all exist and are empty. Depends on PR #2219 being merged. D26: built in parallel with the importer. D27: first live run is a small agency group, then widen. D28: release machinery is shared with 2026-27 (718 referrals already captured) — prove there too.

features.name: F7 — Staff entitlement register (wave 2, paid via payroll)

outcome_metric.metric_name: count of staff referral entitlements recorded, and count marked paid via payroll reference
outcome_metric.baseline_value: 0 recorded, 0 payable — staff CANNOT receive a commission row (FK to education_consultants); 51 distinct staff referrers exist in 2026-27
outcome_metric.threshold_90d: 100% of eligible staff entitlements calculated and recorded by 2026-10-19; payment deferred to payroll go-live
outcome_metric.kill_criterion: If Finance does not confirm the payroll treatment in writing, do NOT pay staff by any route — an employee paid as a supplier is an audit exposure.
outcome_metric.verdict_status: PENDING — blocked on F8 for payment, not for calculation

test_steps: Record a staff entitlement and confirm no bank details are stored for that person (D5).
Attempt to mark a staff entitlement paid before payroll is live — confirm it is BLOCKED.
Confirm staff entitlements are excluded from the agency payout batch (F6).
Confirm the entitlement survives and remains reportable while awaiting wave 2 — nothing is lost or forgotten.
Confirm a staff referrer resolves to a staff row, not an education_consultants row.
features.notes: D4/D5/D7: staff ARE owed, calculated now, paid in wave 2 through payroll with salary. Deliberately no supplier-style payment route. Students are excluded entirely — tracking only.

features.name: F8 — Stand up the MyJKKN payroll module (separate project)
features.priority: P2 — prerequisite for F7 payment only; must NOT block F6

outcome_metric.metric_name: count(hr_employees) and count(hr_payslips) — payroll operational readiness
outcome_metric.baseline_value: hr_employees=0 of 844 staff; hr_pay_scales=0; hr_attendance_records=0; hr_payslips=0; only hr_pay_components (98) is populated (2026-07-21)
outcome_metric.threshold_90d: 844 staff loaded into hr_employees and at least one parallel-run payroll period reconciled against the current external process, by 2026-10-19
outcome_metric.kill_criterion: If a parallel run does not reconcile to the existing salary process, do NOT cut over — this is people's actual pay.

test_steps: Load staff into hr_employees and confirm the count matches the 844 in the staff table.
Generate a payslip for one employee and confirm line items compute correctly.
Run a full period in parallel with the existing process and reconcile totals to the rupee before any cutover.
Add a one-off referral incentive as a payslip line item (is_one_off=true) and confirm it appears correctly.
Confirm no referral entitlement can be marked paid until a real payslip carries it.
features.notes: D8: tracked as its own project so it does not become an unbounded blocker. hr_incentive_schemes (payout_formula, eligibility_criteria, cap_amount) is the designed home for the staff referral incentive. Payroll is BUILT (93 hr_* tables) but UNPOPULATED — the work is a data migration and cutover, not new code.
